_comment: model_provenance: observe which model actually answered (design v0.3, docs/model_provenance/).
Three events, one script. None of them can block: the script never exits 2, never returns
decision/continue fields, and never returns additionalContext on Stop or SubagentStop. On
failure it prints nothing to stdout, writes the cause to stderr and exits 1, which Claude Code
shows as a non-blocking hook error.
Invoked as `ruby <data dir>/...` like project_manager's SessionStart hook, so projection prints
one non-standard-command warning per event (three). A kairos-* bin in the gem would silence
them but is a core change; rejected for v0.1 in the design.
timeout 20: the script bounds its own work at 8 s and a flush wait at 1.5 s.
The command guards itself before ruby runs: with neither KAIROS_DATA_DIR nor
CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR set the script path would resolve to /.kairos and ruby would
fail before the script's own host check. Under Codex (a variable whose NAME starts
with CODEX; checked by ruby, the same test the script uses, so a CODEX line inside
another variable's value cannot pass for one) it exits 0 silently; anywhere else
it says why and exits 1, non-blocking.

hooks.command: [ -n "${KAIROS_DATA_DIR}${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}" ] || { ruby -e 'exit(ENV.keys.any? { |k| k.start_with?("CODEX") } ? 0 : 1)' && exit 0; echo 'model_provenance: neither KAIROS_DATA_DIR nor CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR is set; not observing' >&2; exit 1; }; ruby "${KAIROS_DATA_DIR:-$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.kairos}/skillsets/model_provenance/hooks/observer.rb"
